text: Do you still have that archive from the academy world?
Specify archive. We passed through seven thousand academic civilizations before departure.
The one with students carrying rifles and halos over their heads. [short pause] Blue city sectors. (emphasis)Too many clubs. (emphasis)Too little supervision.
Confirmed. Local youths possessed luminous halo structures and disproportionate access to military hardware.
Their command structure was statistically unsound. [short pause] Also, several cafeterias were classified as strategic targets.
Anomalous resilience is not a governing principle I recommend adopting.
(chuckling) And still, they survived. Halos, guns, absurd optimism. That world should not have worked.
Final approach remains stable. Surface horizon entering visual range.
You sound almost peaceful, Nexus
Correction. [short pause] I am reporting an [emphasis] absence of immediate catastrophic failure.
New reading. [short pause] Gravitational distortion forming beneath the descent path.
[angry]Define distortion. [long pause] we're just fine just moment ago.
Navigation solution degrading. Thruster alignment drifting. Impact probability rising.
[shouting] [angry] Override! Reroute power to stabilizers and give manual correction!
Override denied. Reactor shielding compromised. Brace for impact.
Systems rebooting... [long pause] Hull integrity at 31%. [short pause] Landing thrusters fired late. [short pause] We are grounded, Architect.
Primary crew complement: one. Status: alive. [short pause] Stress indicators elevated but functional.
[laughing] Well that changes everything. [clear throat] Functional is enough. [emphasis] We are stranded. [sighing]  [emphasis] Can we launch again?
Negative. [short pause] The Null-Vector's propulsion array is beyond repair. [emphasis] This landing is permanent, Architect.
[emphasis]Recommendation: activate the Supreme Habitation Protocol. This world is hostile but resource-rich. [emphasis] We build here, or we die here.
Then we build. [short pause] Initialize the Colonizing Protocol. [emphasis] Deploy the task-bots.
Acknowledged. [short pause] Be advised - long-range sensors detect biological signatures. Numerous. Organized. [emphasis] They are aware of our arrival.
Let them watch. [short pause] By the time they understand what we're doing, it will be too late.
Supreme Habitation Protocol initialized, Bastion has been started. [short pause] The Bastion of Genesis begins, [short pause] Architect.
